verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers login flows, SSO, MFA, RBAC, Organizations, and AI-agent security features, but contains no documentation of session lifetime configuration, refresh-token rotation/expiry controls, or an API/dashboard action for immediately revoking a live session — a core, expected capability for an identity platform. Since this is a fair and applicable axis for Auth0 but no supporting evidence is present, it cannot be credited as full/partial.
